title: The public preview for Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28) is available
summary: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28) public preview is available for testing in sandbox environments. Preview sandboxes cannot be upgraded to production and may be updated or deleted without notice.
key_points: Public preview for BC28 (W1 28.0) can be created in the Business Central admin center
Preview sandboxes are for testing only and cannot be converted to production environments
General availability is expected on March 18, 2026
Major update timing changed in BC25: from 30-60 days to 5 months with optional minor updates

quotes.text: Sandboxes on a preview version are intended only for testing and review of features coming in the next release.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that preview sandboxes serve a specific testing purpose and have limitations

quotes.text: The environment cannot be updated to a production version. It must remain in preview until it is deleted.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical constraint for administrators to understand that preview environments cannot transition to production
